items.title: Cauvery Water Management Authority Meets on July 30
items.whyInNews: The Cauvery Water Management Authority (CWMA) met on July 30, 2026, to discuss the release of water from the Cauvery river to Tamil Nadu.
items.summary: The CWMA met on July 30, 2026, to discuss the release of water from the Cauvery river to Tamil Nadu, with the authority deciding to release 50,000 cusecs of water to Tamil Nadu. The decision was taken after considering the net inflow to the four reservoirs in Karnataka during the current season. The CWMA is headed by Vineet Gupta, with the authority comprising representatives from the governments of Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Kerala, and Puducherry.
